statements.t: We expect Lakeland and Davie to be substantially complete in the fourth quarter of 2026, followed by Camp Lake in the first quarter of 2027.

Our three merchant build projects located in Delray, Florida and Hamilton and Parsippany, New Jersey, totaling 510,307 square feet where FRP owns a minority interest, are in the early stages of lease-up.
We intend to monetize these investments following stabilization and recycle the proceeds into future industrial opportunities.”
• We expect our Lakeland and Davie warehouses to be substantially complete by the first of the year with Camp Lake to follow in the first quarter of 2027
